They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Cervantes Saavedra, Miguel de, 1547-1616; Viardot, Louis, 1800-1883 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: L'ingénieux hidalgo don Quichotte de la Manche, Paris, Garnier frères, 1840, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/lingnieuxhidalg00panngoog. The scan does not show the credit of Louis Viardot, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
